description: Against a real SQLite: a client `!` function calling two `!` server functions, composed into one request with one envelope. book(1, 1) fails in the second call — the first call's row is rolled back too; book(2, 0) commits both. Count 2 (3 if the first call had committed on its own), @r = 3, @status = booked.
rationale: S474 (user-voice-scrml.md, the four one-way doors, door 2): "F11 becomes INTERIM: a client `!`'s server calls compose into one request with one envelope (planner composition, per §19.9.9.8 rule 1)". Was E-TX-CLIENT-MULTI-CALL (S473 F11, permanent).
